data.name: Eloralintide
data.description: Selective, long-acting amylin receptor agonist administered SC QW at doses of 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, or 9 mg for 64 weeks for body weight reduction in participants with overweight or obesity and T2D

data.name: Placebo
data.description: Matching placebo administered SC QW for 64 weeks

data.name: Oral antihyperglycemic medications (AHMs)
data.description: Stable background oral AHMs (excluding incretins; DPP-4i allowed) for T2D management; up to 3 oral AHMs permitted at stable dose for at least 90 days prior to screening

data.name: Lifestyle counseling (healthy nutrition and physical activity)
data.description: All participants receive lifestyle-modification counseling including healthy diet and physical activity guidance throughout the study, consistent with current guidelines for weight management

data.name: Diabetes education
data.description: Diabetes education consistent with guidelines for T2D management provided to all participants with T2D

data.name: Rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia
data.description: Glycemic rescue therapy including urgent short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting for severe, persistent hyperglycemia; study intervention to be temporarily interrupted when insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy

duration.text: 64 weeks (no dose escalation required for 1.5 mg arm)

data.name: Eloralintide dose escalation: 3 mg QW (escalation step 1)

duration.text: 4 weeks (Weeks 0–4, first escalation step toward 3 mg maintenance)
52 weeks maintenance after 12-week dose escalation period (total treatment 64 weeks)

data.name: Eloralintide dose escalation: 3 mg then 6 mg QW (escalation steps toward 6 mg)

duration.text: 12 weeks dose escalation (stepping through doses every 4 weeks)
52 weeks maintenance after 12-week dose escalation period (total treatment 64 weeks)

data.name: Eloralintide dose escalation: 3 mg, 6 mg, then 9 mg QW (escalation steps toward 9 mg)

duration.text: 12 weeks dose escalation (stepping through each dose every 4 weeks)

data.description: Dose: 3 mg escalating to 6 mg escalating to 9 mg

duration.text: 52 weeks maintenance after 12-week dose escalation period (total treatment 64 weeks)

data.name: eloralintide
data.description: Selective, long-acting amylin receptor agonist; also known as LY3841136; investigational active pharmaceutical ingredient for treatment of obesity or overweight with T2D
